config.comment.builderfocusblocks: Default OFF. Applies explicit allow/hide rules to normal blocks, block entities and Chise overlays. Hide takes precedence over highlights.
config.comment.builderfocusentities: Default OFF. Applies an explicit keep/hide rule set to entity rendering for inspection tasks.
config.comment.finethreadtrace: Visualize nearby visible tripwire and hooks within a bounded local radius.
config.comment.glassinspection: Adds sparse full-bright markers to glass blocks and panes while preserving the active resource-pack model and stained color.
config.comment.hiddensurfacetrace: Default OFF. Visualizes selected hidden builder targets in nearby already-loaded chunks. Unloaded chunks are never force-loaded.
config.comment.kelphighlight: Highlight visible kelp and kelp plants with a magenta and orange two-color neon overlay.
config.comment.localfirevisibility: Default OFF. Lowers only the first-person fire overlay while leaving world fire and resource-pack textures unchanged.
config.comment.locallavahighlight: Default OFF. Visualizes nearby lava source boundaries through terrain using the shared bounded Occluded Highlights budget. Flowing lava remains unchanged.
config.comment.materialhighlights: Add ore-matched animated frames to ores, ancient debris and obsidian while preserving their normal appearance.
config.comment.netherpalette: Color-code visible Nether construction materials with bounded local line overlays.
config.option.builderfocusblockblacklist: Block IDs hidden by Visual Filter.
How the Visual Filter block lists are interpreted.
config.option.builderfocusblockwhitelist: Block IDs kept visible by Visual Filter.
config.option.builderfocusentityblacklis: Entity IDs hidden by Visual Filter.
config.option.builderfocusentityrulemode: How the Visual Filter entity lists are interpreted.
config.option.builderfocusentitywhitelis: Entity IDs kept visible by Visual Filter.
config.option.localworksitevisibilityhor: Horizontal radius for bounded local visibility scans.
config.option.localworksitevisibilitymax: Maximum visible blocks rendered by the bounded world overlay.
config.option.localworksitevisibilityver: Vertical radius for bounded local visibility scans.
config.option.localworksitevisibilitywor: Draw line markers generated by Chise instead of replacing block textures.
config.option.refreshbuilderfocusrendere: Reload visible chunks after Visual Filter block rules change.
help.chisetweaks.builder_focus_blocks.re: Large list changes can request a chunk-render refresh.
help.chisetweaks.builder_focus_blocks.su: Creates a temporary block-focused scene across normal blocks, block entities and Chise overlays. Hidden blocks stay hidden even when a highlight is enabled.
help.chisetweaks.builder_focus_blocks.us: Under Visual Filter, open Block targets, choose Allow list or Hide list, register block IDs, then enable Block Filter.
General occlusion and performance culling remain delegated to dedicated rendering mods.
Builds a temporary entity-focused scene from a declared visibility list.
Under Visual Filter, open Entity targets, choose Allow list or Hide list, register entity IDs, then enable Entity Filter.
help.chisetweaks.fine_thread_trace.requi: Client-only. It never loads chunks and line-of-sight filtering is enabled by default.
help.chisetweaks.fine_thread_trace.summa: Highlights nearby visible tripwire and hooks for technical-build inspection.
help.chisetweaks.fine_thread_trace.usage: Enable Fine Line Highlight and approach the mechanism. Chise draws bounded visible line markers.
help.chisetweaks.fire_visibility.require: Client-only and default OFF. No texture replacement, world mutation, chunk scan or server packet is used.
help.chisetweaks.fire_visibility.summary: Lowers the first-person fire overlay so the center of the screen remains easier to see while burning.
help.chisetweaks.fire_visibility.usage: Under Visibility, enable Low Fire. World fire and the active resource pack remain unchanged.
help.chisetweaks.glass_inspection.requir: Client-only and default OFF. Uses Minecraft's normal block-model path with no world scan, raycast, server packet or texture replacement.
help.chisetweaks.glass_inspection.summar: Keeps stained-glass colors intact while using a cyan face motif for glass blocks and an amber center rail for glass panes.
help.chisetweaks.glass_inspection.usage: Under Highlight, enable Glass Highlight. Clear, tinted and all vanilla stained-glass blocks and panes receive the shape-specific Chise marker.
help.chisetweaks.hidden_surface_trace.re: No wall-through display, world mutation or server packet is used.
help.chisetweaks.hidden_surface_trace.su: Identifies visible powder snow, blue ice, dead coral and sculk catalyst blocks.
help.chisetweaks.hidden_surface_trace.us: Enable Hidden Block Highlight while inspecting a local work area. Visible targets receive bounded line markers.
help.chisetweaks.kelp_highlight.requirem: Client-only and default OFF. Uses Minecraft's normal block-model path with no world scan, raycast, chunk loading, world mutation or server packet.
help.chisetweaks.kelp_highlight.summary: Highlights kelp with a magenta-and-orange neon X overlay designed to stand out from green kelp and blue water.
help.chisetweaks.kelp_highlight.usage: Under Highlight, enable Kelp Highlight. Kelp and kelp plants receive a two-color neon marker; the emphasis swaps slowly without rapid flashing.
help.chisetweaks.lava_highlight.requirem: Client-only and default OFF. It checks only a bounded nearby area in already-loaded chunks and intentionally displays lava-source frames through terrain. It does not load chunks, mutate the world or send server packets. Shaders can affect final appearance.
help.chisetweaks.lava_highlight.summary: Highlights nearby lava source blocks through terrain and strengthens the deep-green 1x1x1 full-bright frame toward #075B32 as you approach.
help.chisetweaks.lava_highlight.usage: Under Analyzer, enable Lava Analyzer. Nearby source blocks receive cube frames; within 2 blocks the frame reaches #075B32. Flowing lava remains unchanged.
help.chisetweaks.material_highlights.req: Client-only and opt-in. Uses Minecraft's normal block-model path with no wall-through display, extra visibility scan or server packet.
help.chisetweaks.material_highlights.sum: Highlights ores, ancient debris and obsidian with ore-matched animated frames while preserving their normal textures.
help.chisetweaks.material_highlights.usa: Under Highlight, enable Ore Highlights and choose the ore families to emphasize. Chise coalesces any required resource reload automatically.
help.chisetweaks.nether_palette.requirem: No resource replacement, chunk loading, world mutation or server packet is used.
help.chisetweaks.nether_palette.summary: Groups visible Nether construction materials with small, color-coded outlines.
help.chisetweaks.nether_palette.usage: Enable Nether Highlight while comparing adjacent Nether palette blocks in a bounded local area.
screen.chisetweaks.help.subtitle: Review 16 toggleable runtime features. Bright Chest / Bright Concrete default ON; the other 14 default OFF.

screen.chisetweaks.settings.ore_motion.d: Keep highlights static when OFF or use subtle motion when ON.

screen.chisetweaks.scene_filter.title: Scene Filter target editor
screen.chisetweaks.settings.fire_size.de: Choose Large, Medium or Small. Chise reuses the current Minecraft/resource-pack fire sprite for both normal fire and soul fire; no texture replacement or resource reload is used.
screen.chisetweaks.inspector.title: Crosshair Inspector
screen.chisetweaks.inspector.no_target.d: Aim at a block or entity, then open this tab. The Inspector uses Minecraft's existing crosshair hit without another raycast.
screen.chisetweaks.placement.title: Placement State Preview
screen.chisetweaks.pattern.title: Pattern Consistency
screen.chisetweaks.pattern.select.name: Use crosshair block as reference
screen.chisetweaks.pattern.select.descri: Lock the targeted BlockState as truth; no majority inference is used.
screen.chisetweaks.pattern.inactive.desc: Select a block. Only the same ID in loaded client chunks is compared.
screen.chisetweaks.help.highlight.name: Highlight
screen.chisetweaks.help.highlight.descri: Make ores, fine lines, glass and kelp easier to see. Highlight features can be enabled together.
screen.chisetweaks.help.filter.name: Filter
screen.chisetweaks.help.filter.descripti: Organize Block and Entity rendering locally. Filter settings never change server world state.
screen.chisetweaks.help.analyzer.name: Analyzer
screen.chisetweaks.help.analyzer.descrip: Analyze nearby lava sources, hidden blocks and villager job-site relationships using already loaded client data without force-loading chunks.
screen.chisetweaks.help.visibility.name: Visibility
screen.chisetweaks.help.visibility.descr: Improve fire, Chest and White Concrete visibility. Low Fire reuses the current normal-fire or soul-fire sprite and changes only first-person geometry; Bright features use direct rendering without Resource Pack reload.
screen.chisetweaks.help.settings.name: Settings
screen.chisetweaks.help.settings.descrip: The footer changes to Apply when edits are pending. With no edits, Reset affects only the current settings tab.
If a problem occurs, inspect the Prism Launcher console or logs/latest.log. Diagnostics are not duplicated in this screen.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.hidden_range: Horizontal range used to inspect hidden-block targets in already loaded chunks.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.hidden_verti: Vertical range used to inspect hidden-block targets.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.hidden_max.d: Maximum number of retained through-wall hidden-block markers.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.dimensi: Automatically use the bounded Nether visibility profile when appropriate.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.fine_li: AUTO keeps the current Chise palette.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.village: Links nearby villagers to their claimed job sites. If client JOB_SITE memory is unavailable, a bounded loaded-world workstation fallback is used.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.hidden_: AUTO keeps the Chise hidden-block palette.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.fire_vi: Lower only the first-person fire overlay.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.bright_: Improve Chest and Double Chest visibility.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.beacon_: Show the horizontal effect radius of nearby active Beacons.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.lightni: Show the vanilla 128-block horizontal Lightning Rod attraction range.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.masa_su: Optional integration that assists and controls existing Masa-mod features. ChiseTweaks does not perform automation itself.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.masa_ja: Auto enables Japanese UX assistance only when Minecraft is using Japanese.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.masa_gu: Explains which Masa mod owns each feature and where to configure it.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.pick_re: When Litematica requests a block item that is unavailable, use a configured replacement candidate.
Edit Schematic Block → Replacement Block mappings.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.tool_sw: Control Tweakeroo Tool Switch with Chise allow/deny policy.
Edit Block IDs allowed or denied for Tool Switch.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.gamma_o: Assist only with restoring Gamma Override state owned by Tweakeroo.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.auto_pi: Control TweakerMore Auto Pick with an item allow/deny policy.
Edit Item IDs allowed or denied for Auto Pick.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.materia: Synchronize the existing Material List display after TweakerMore material collection completes.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.require: Require Shift while removing a shared schematic.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.nvidium: Not installed - World Border Fix is a no-op.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.world_b: Temporarily suppress Nvidium only in risk zones where rendering can fail near world borders or far coordinates.
Reduce transparency/X-ray-like rendering failures near the world border.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.border_: Treat positions within this distance of the world border as suppression candidates.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.far_coo: Reduce Nvidium rendering failures at large X/Z coordinates.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.coord_t: Treat |X| or |Z| at or above this value as a suppression candidate.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.nvidium: Reload rendering to re-enable Nvidium immediately after leaving a risk zone. OFF by default; keep OFF for stability.

screen.chisetweaks.inspector.interaction: Keep up to 64 recent placement, break, item-use, and entity interactions in memory only. Chat, signs, books, and container contents are never recorded.
screen.chisetweaks.inspector.schematic_i: Compare the current placement prediction with the Litematica schematic as MATCH / COMPATIBLE / DIFFERENT. Placement itself is never blocked.
screen.chisetweaks.inspector.schematic.n: When Litematica and Schematic Placement Inspector are enabled, placing a block on the schematic shows the comparison result here.
screen.chisetweaks.inspector.interaction: When Interaction History is enabled, recent read-only interactions appear here.
config.comment.handheldsize: Default OFF. Scales only the submitted first-person item model; it does not replace item models, textures, resource packs, animations or input.
help.chisetweaks.handheld_size.requireme: Client-only and default OFF. No model JSON, texture replacement, resource reload, world mutation or input injection is used.
help.chisetweaks.handheld_size.summary: Reduces first-person item obstruction with semantic Block / Item / Weapons & Tools scale profiles while keeping the active resource pack.
help.chisetweaks.handheld_size.usage: Under Visibility, enable Handheld Size and adjust Block, Item and Weapons & Tools percentages. Shield stays near vanilla at 95%.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.handhel: Shrink only first-person held item models without replacing the active resource pack. Main hand and offhand use the same semantic profile.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.handheld_blo: Relative scale for first-person BlockItem rendering. Default 70%.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.handheld_ite: Relative scale for first-person non-block, non-tool items. Default 60%.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.handheld_too: Relative scale for tools and weapons detected by item components or vanilla weapon/tool classes. Default 75%.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.copy.village: Draws links only for nearby villagers whose JOB_SITE relation is already known by Minecraft. Unknown workstations are not guessed or scanned.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.occluded_ran: Shared horizontal radius for Lava Source and Occluded Blocks in already-loaded chunks.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.occluded_ver: Shared vertical radius for occluded builder highlights.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.occluded_int: Shared tick interval for the bounded Lava Source / Occluded Blocks traversal.
screen.chisetweaks.settings.occluded_max: Maximum retained markers per enabled occluded target family.
screen.chisetweaks.builder_assist.no_tar: Look at a block or entity to show a small, read-only summary.
screen.chisetweaks.integrations.litemati: Compare the current vanilla placement prediction with Litematica's expected block without blocking or automating placement.
screen.chisetweaks.help.visual.name: Visual Tweaks
screen.chisetweaks.help.visual.descripti: Small first-person and lighting adjustments: Low Fire, Handheld Size and Bright Blocks.
screen.chisetweaks.help.builder_highligh: Emphasize useful building materials and optional occluded targets with bounded client-side visualization.
screen.chisetweaks.help.technical_visual: Show tripwire traces, infrastructure ranges and known Villager → Job Site links.
screen.chisetweaks.help.scene_filter.des: Temporarily hide or retain selected blocks and entities on your own screen.
screen.chisetweaks.help.builder_assist.d: Read BlockState, preview vanilla placement and compare a local pattern without automating input.
screen.chisetweaks.help.workflow.name: Workflow
screen.chisetweaks.help.workflow.descrip: Keep a bounded, memory-only history of recent building interactions.
screen.chisetweaks.help.integrations.des: Optional Masa and renderer compatibility tweaks; missing external mods remain no-op.
